sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Compensation for Damage - Wergild is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know, doing errands all day is still not enough to improve your poor situation. I think there is and easier way. Bribe the right people and they'll sing praises about how amazing you are. For example, you can compensate the friends of those you killed due to your brain disorder. Something like a wergild for murder in the Middle Ages."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Fence Rep +1
"Outstanding. Part of the compensation will go where it needs to go, and the other part will stay with me. Let's say it's for maintaining our cooperation."
